evidence.title: Canvas UI: Creative Canvas, WebGL and WebGPU Component Library

name: Canvas UI Components
summary: Open-source library of 35 creative canvas effects for live HTML, with WebGL and WebGPU builds for six frameworks.
description: Component gallery of html-in-canvas effects such as ASCII lenses, glass, fire, ripples, glitch and particle reveals. Each effect ships for React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JS in WebGL (GLSL) and WebGPU (vgpu) builds, installable with the shadcn CLI.
contains: 420 shadcn registry items across framework and renderer variants
WebGL and WebGPU (vgpu) builds of every effect
framework variants for React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JS
